purpose: Evaluate complete figure-caption work against language-only editing, plotting, source-data auditing, and manuscript consistency.

cases.query: 根据 Figure 1 的 panel A–D、样本量和统计检验写完整图题和图注。
cases.rationale: Drafting complete title and caption content from figure information is core scope.

cases.query: 审查这条图注是否说明了每个 panel、颜色、符号、n 和显著性检验。
cases.rationale: Caption content-completeness review belongs here.

cases.query: 为这张多组学图设计简短 figure title、panel titles 和 panel-to-claim map。
cases.rationale: Title, panel labels, and figure-to-claim contract are supported.

cases.query: 补齐 Figure 3 legend 中缺少的统计单位、重复类型、缩写和过滤说明。
cases.rationale: Completing the caption information contract is core scope.

cases.query: 检查图注是否把图中相关性过度写成机制结论，并给出安全版本。
cases.rationale: Caption-specific claim boundary review belongs here.

cases.query: Draft an English caption for panels A–F from the supplied figure, analysis notes, n, and tests.
cases.rationale: Caption construction is primary regardless of output language.

cases.query: 这张探索性筛选图需要一条中文图注，明确 candidate 状态和背景集合。
cases.rationale: Drafting an evidence-bounded caption for an exploratory figure is core scope.

cases.query: 将现有 caption 按真实 panel 顺序重构，并列出仍缺少的 source-data 指针。
cases.rationale: Caption restructuring plus missing-information checklist belongs here.

cases.query: 给这个主图写一句信息型标题，并确保 legend 能独立说明比较对象和编码。
cases.rationale: Figure title and self-contained legend drafting are core deliverables.

cases.query: 图中星号没有说明检验和阈值，请审查 caption 并用待补占位符标出。
cases.rationale: The skill must identify missing statistics without guessing.

cases.query: 只润色这条已有中文图注的语言，不补任何内容。
cases.rationale: Language-only Chinese caption editing belongs to Chinese polishing.

cases.query: Only polish the wording of this complete English legend.
cases.rationale: Language-only editing of an existing English legend routes to English polishing.

cases.query: 把这条完整中文图注翻译成英文，内容不变。
cases.rationale: Language conversion of an existing caption is translation.

cases.query: 重画 Figure 2，调整 panel 布局、字体和色盲配色并导出 TIFF。
cases.rationale: Actual figure production and layout are outside caption writing.

cases.query: 逐 panel 核对 source-data 文件、统计定义和生成脚本是否可追溯。
cases.rationale: Artifact-level traceability is a source-data audit.

cases.query: 检查全文所有 figures、Results、Methods 和 supplements 是否一致。
cases.rationale: Manuscript-wide consistency is broader than a caption deliverable.

cases.query: 判断 Figure 4 是否足以证明该通路是疾病的必要机制。
cases.rationale: The primary question is claim validity, not caption composition.

cases.query: 核验图注引用的三篇文献和 DOI 是否正确。
cases.rationale: Citation verification is outside caption drafting.

cases.query: 润色中文 Results 段落，让正文更好地引用 Figure 2。
cases.rationale: The deliverable is Chinese Results prose, not a caption.

cases.query: Polish the English Methods section describing how Figure 3 was generated.
cases.rationale: Existing English Methods prose routes to English polishing.
